Device sign in runs in the core. Action::DeviceSignIn asks for a code, and polling runs on next_wake_ms, one interval from each answer. slow_down adds 5 s. expired_token, or a code past its life, fetches a new code with no press. access_denied waits for a press. A network failure keeps polling with no notice. A 503 unsupported sets off. A session from any path ends it. The device code reaches no view and is not kept.
/activate is a place that takes an account and no profile, even where visitors may browse. RouteTarget.code carries its code to the screen. A visitor keeps the whole address through sign in as next.

A device code takes one answer. Approve and deny refuse a code already answered with 403 error.device_decided, in one conditional write, so of two answers at once one lands. A poll writes only its own time, so it cannot wipe an answer.
